snippet.title: Teaser Satellite Odyssey: Prologue - Retrofuturistic Sci-Fi Game - Short story-driven adventure
snippet.description:
✨🚀 Satellite Odyssey: Prologue -is the first installment in this series—a concise (1-hour) first-person, story-driven adventure with gripping horror elements. 

Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of classic science fiction and retro-futurism, inspired by Soviet sci-fi films and humanity's thirst for knowledge and the conquest of space. The future, as envisioned by the Soviet mind. Rapid advancements in robotics, expeditions to distant stars and planets in the quest for signs of life.

You are Laska, a Soviet robopsychologist and a member of the scientific space expedition “Icarus”. Awakened from an extended anabiosis, she goes on a routine shift with the station's artificial intelligence Zarya.
But the mission quickly takes an unexpected turn...
Laska has to figure out what happened on the station and make an extremely difficult choice...
